products.name: Fiberon PA6-CF20
products.annealing: Required: 100 C for 16 h (TDS and wiki), then moisture-condition 48 h.
products.notes: Warp-Free nylon: keep build plate AND ambient air below 50 C (open chamber doors); no enclosure. All-metal hotend + hardened/ruby nozzle (brass nozzle life ~9 h per TDS). Very hygroscopic: print from a heated dryer, store <20% RH. TDS chamber temperature: 'Room Temp.' Moisture-condition parts after annealing. Black only. Also 1 kg and 3 kg spools. Fan OFF. Support: PolyDissolve S1. HDT up to 215 C annealed.

products.name: Fiberon PA6-GF25
products.annealing: Required: 100 C for 16 h (TDS; shop page says 10-16 h), then moisture-condition.
products.notes: Warp-Free nylon: keep build plate AND ambient air below 50 C (open chamber doors); no enclosure. All-metal hotend + hardened/ruby nozzle (brass nozzle life ~9 h per TDS). Very hygroscopic: print from a heated dryer, store <20% RH. TDS chamber temperature: 'Room Temp.' Moisture-condition parts after annealing. Grey only. 0.5 kg and 3 kg spools (no 1 kg). Fan OFF. Support: PolyDissolve S1. HDT up to 191 C annealed.

products.name: Fiberon PA612-CF15
products.variant: 15% carbon fiber PA612 long-chain copolyamide (ex PolyMide PA612-CF)
products.annealing: Required: 100 C for 16 h, then moisture-condition.
products.notes: Warp-Free nylon: keep build plate AND ambient air below 50 C (open chamber doors); no enclosure. All-metal hotend + hardened/ruby nozzle (brass nozzle life ~9 h per TDS). Very hygroscopic: print from a heated dryer, store <20% RH. TDS chamber temperature: 'Room Temp.' Moisture-condition parts after annealing. Lower moisture sensitivity than PA6. All-metal hotend 250 C+. Black; 0.5/1/3 kg spools. Fan OFF. Support: PolySupport for PA12 or PolyDissolve S1.

products.name: Fiberon PA12-CF10
products.variant: 10% carbon fiber PA12 long-chain copolyamide (ex PolyMide PA12-CF)
products.annealing: Required: 100 C for 16 h, then moisture-condition.
products.notes: Warp-Free nylon: keep build plate AND ambient air below 50 C (open chamber doors); no enclosure. All-metal hotend + hardened/ruby nozzle (brass nozzle life ~9 h per TDS). Very hygroscopic: print from a heated dryer, store <20% RH. TDS chamber temperature: 'Room Temp.' Moisture-condition parts after annealing. Low moisture absorption vs PA6. products.name: Fiberon PA612-ESD
products.variant: PA612 + 10% carbon fiber + carbon nanotubes, ESD-safe (10^4-10^7 ohm/sq)
products.annealing: Optional/recommended: TDS 100 C for 16 h; wiki tips say 100 C for 10 h. Moisture-condition after.
products.notes: Warp-Free nylon: keep build plate AND ambient air below 50 C (open chamber doors); no enclosure. All-metal hotend + hardened/ruby nozzle (brass nozzle life ~9 h per TDS). Very hygroscopic: print from a heated dryer, store <20% RH. TDS chamber temperature: 'Room Temp.' Moisture-condition parts after annealing. Surface resistivity drops with higher nozzle temp (280->320 C). HDT 157 C @0.45 MPa. Not UL94 V0. Black; 0.5 kg and 3 kg on shop (wiki FAQ also mentions 1 kg). Fan OFF (TDS Z specimens 80%). Support: PolySupport for PA12.

products.name: Fiberon PET-CF17
products.annealing: Recommended: 120 C for 10 h (raises HDT from ~70 C to >100 C). Thin parts: ramp 80-100 C first or anneal 100 C ~14 h. Wait 24 h after printing or 80 C/2 h stress relief before annealing.
products.notes: All-metal hotend 270 C+ and hardened nozzle. Enclosure not needed (keep door open). Fan OFF. Less moisture sensitive; dryer may be needed in humid climates, store dry. Black; 0.5/1/3 kg spools. Support: PolySupport for PA12 (community: HT-PLA).

products.name: Fiberon PET-GF15
products.variant: 15% glass fiber PET (glass, not carbon; 6 colors)
products.annealing: Optional: 120 C for 16 h only if service temp >80 C (HDT to 133 C @0.45 MPa). Dimensional change <0.5% after anneal.
products.notes: All-metal hotend, hardened nozzle (brass life ~9 h). Fan OFF. TDS chamber: room temp; wiki FAQ: prints on open-frame but enclosed/heated-chamber printer recommended for best results. Moisture sensitive, store <20% RH. Sold in 1 kg (6 colors) and 3 kg spools (no 500 g). Prints may stick hard to clean textured PEI - let plate cool. Possible slight surface discoloration from crystallinity differences.

products.name: Fiberon PETG-rCF08
products.notes: Hardened nozzle required; all-metal hotend recommended but not required. Fan 0-50% (wiki: max 50%, reduce for layer adhesion). Enclosure not needed, keep door open. Store <20% RH. Black; 0.5 kg and 3 kg spools.

products.name: Fiberon PETG-ESD
products.variant: PETG + carbon nanotubes, ESD-safe (ex PolyMax PETG-ESD); no fiber
products.notes: Fiberon FAQ states PETG-ESD is the only non-abrasive Fiberon material, although the product page boilerplate still says 'hardened nozzle due to abrasiveness' - hardened nozzle advisable but not strictly required. All-metal hotend 250 C+ recommended. Fan: TDS OFF, wiki max 50%. Speed: TDS up to 500 mm/s, wiki table 30-300 mm/s. Surface resistivity ~10^7 ohm at 250 C down to <10^4 at 290 C (higher nozzle temp = lower resistivity). Black; 0.5/1/3 kg spools.

products.name: Fiberon PPS-CF10
products.annealing: Recommended: 125 C for 16 h for best layer adhesion and heat resistance (HDT ~250 C annealed).
products.notes: Hotend must reach 310 C+ (300 C possible only very slowly). Hardened nozzle. No heated chamber required; TDS chamber: room temp, wiki ambient 25-80 C acceptable. Fan OFF. Low moisture sensitivity but store <20% RH. Very brittle on spool: straight filament path, avoid AMS. Internal FR test shows V0 behaviour but not UL94 certified. Black; 0.5 kg and 3 kg spools. Support: PolySupport for PA12.

products.name: Fiberon PPS-GF20
products.variant: 20% glass fiber polyphenylene sulfide (glass, not carbon; electrically insulating)
products.annealing: Recommended: 130 C for 10 h (HDT 236 C @0.45 MPa); 230 C anneal gives max heat resistance (219.6 C @1.8 MPa).
products.notes: Hotend 310 C+ and hardened nozzle. No heated chamber required; TDS chamber room temp, wiki ambient 25-80 C. Fan OFF. UL94 V0 at 1.5 mm. Water absorption 0.11%; dry 100 C/10 h if damp. Brittle on spool: clear filament path (works in Bambu AMS per wiki). Grey; 0.5 kg and 3 kg spools. Support: PolySupport for PA12.

products.name: Fiberon ASA-CF08
products.variant: 8% carbon fiber ASA, UV/weather resistant, 6 colors
products.annealing: Not required (TDS: N/A); full performance as printed.
products.notes: All-metal hotend 260 C+, hardened nozzle (brass life ~9 h). Enclosure recommended (TDS: enclosed printer recommended, wiki table 'Enclosure Recommended'; heated chamber not required). Fan OFF. Releases styrene VOCs - ventilate/filter. Brittle filament: bend diameter >60 mm, caution in AMS. Let parts cool before removal. HDT 103 C @0.45 MPa. 0.5 kg spools in 6 colors, 3 kg in black. Support: PolySupport for PA12.
